stories.title: En RD Congo, l'ex-président Joseph Kabila et le M23 s'allient dans un mouvement politico-militaire

en.title: In DR Congo, former president Joseph Kabila and M23 form alliance in political-military movement
en.summary: Former Congolese president Joseph Kabila, sentenced to death in absentia for treason, has assumed leadership of a new political-military formation that includes the M23 group backed by Rwanda.

stories.title: Faille logicielle, frigos à 35 °C, des millions d’euros perdus : les dessous de la cyberattaque inédite qui a frappé les supermarchés français

en.title: Software flaw, refrigerators at 35°C, millions of euros lost: details of unprecedented cyberattack on French supermarkets
en.summary: A major cyberattack targeted refrigeration infrastructure at leading French retail chains, disrupting a critical component of the country's food supply chain and causing substantial financial losses.

stories.title: A Aubagne, un élève tire sur un principal et une professeure : « Maman, il y a un tueur dans le collège »

en.title: In Aubagne, a student shoots at principal and teacher: "Mom, there's a killer in the school"
en.summary: A 14-year-old student opened fire at his school after bringing a shotgun onto campus, wounding the principal and a teacher. The motives for the attack remain under investigation.

stories.title: «On est tous partis se cacher» : à Aubagne, un principal et une enseignante de collège blessés par des tirs de fusil d’un élève

en.title: "We all went to hide": in Aubagne, school principal and teacher wounded by rifle fire from student
en.summary: A 14-year-old was arrested after firing a rifle at his school in Bouches-du-Rhône, injuring the principal and a teacher. Prosecutors are investigating the incident as attempted murder.

stories.title: Arabie Saoudite : les ambitions du prince Mohammed ben Salmane mises à mal par les frappes des Houthis

en.title: Saudi Arabia: Prince Mohammed bin Salman's ambitions undermined by Houthi strikes
en.summary: The WPC Energy summit is taking place in Riyadh amid attacks by Yemeni Houthi rebels on Saudi airports. The escalation threatens the Saudi kingdom's economic opening.

stories.title: Dans les supermarchés français, une journée noire après une cyberattaque massive visant des systèmes frigorifiques

en.title: In French supermarkets, a dark day after a massive cyberattack targeting refrigeration systems
en.summary: Hundreds of stores experienced massive product losses when refrigeration systems were compromised overnight on October 11-12. A flaw in software from Danish company Danfoss was identified as responsible.

stories.title: Un suspect de 14 ans, un principal et une professeure blessés... Ce que l'on sait des tirs par arme à feu dans un collège d'Aubagne

en.title: 14-year-old suspect, principal and teacher wounded... What we know about the shooting at a middle school in Aubagne
en.summary: A 14-year-old student opened fire at a middle school in Aubagne, wounding the principal and a teacher. The suspect was quickly arrested and interior and education ministers visited the scene.

stories.title: Attaque dans un collège d’Aubagne, des frigos de supermarchés hackés, sanctions de l’UE contre la Russie… L’actu de ce lundi 12 octobre

en.title: Attack at a middle school in Aubagne, supermarket refrigerators hacked, EU sanctions against Russia... News from Monday October 12
en.summary: Libération summarizes the main news stories from Monday October 12, including an attack at a school, cyberattacks on supermarkets, and European sanctions.

stories.title: Des frigos chauffés à 50 °C : une cyberattaque hors norme dans des centaines de supermarchés français

en.title: Refrigerators heated to 50°C: an unprecedented cyberattack in hundreds of French supermarkets
en.summary: A cyberattack compromised legacy refrigeration control systems affecting hundreds of French supermarkets overnight Sunday to Monday. Other European countries may also be affected.

stories.title: Un élève ouvre le feu dans un collège d'Aubagne, le proviseur et une enseignante blessés

en.title: A student opens fire at a middle school in Aubagne, the principal and a teacher wounded
en.summary: A 14-year-old student fired a shotgun at Joseph-Lakanal middle school in Aubagne, wounding the principal and a teacher. The Marseille prosecutor opened an investigation for attempted murder charges.

stories.title: Principal d’un collège et une enseignante blessés à l’arme à feu à Aubagne : les réactions des politiques

en.title: Principal of a middle school and a teacher wounded by gunfire in Aubagne: political reactions
en.summary: A 14-year-old student opened fire with a shotgun at his middle school in Aubagne on Monday morning, injuring the principal and a teacher before being disarmed by staff. The incident appears unrelated to ongoing student protests.

stories.title: Les réfrigérateurs de centaines de supermarchés français victimes d'une cyberattaque

en.title: Refrigerators at hundreds of French supermarkets hit by cyberattack
en.summary: A major cyberattack targeted refrigeration systems at approximately 150-200 Intermarché stores and fewer than 100 Coopérative U locations overnight Sunday to Monday. Significant quantities of perishable goods may need to be discarded for food safety reasons, and authorities have launched an investigation.

stories.title: Gazole : comment la libération des stocks stratégiques va profiter concrètement aux automobilistes

en.title: Diesel: how the release of strategic stocks will concretely benefit motorists
en.summary: Diesel prices at fuel pumps are expected to drop starting November 1st following the release of refined product reserves. Not all gas stations will be ready by that date, and authorities are studying lower mandatory storage requirements to prevent rapid price increases.

stories.title: 400 000 fonctionnaires en moins, une nouvelle réforme des retraites…: le remède de Bruno Retailleau pour redresser les finances publiques

en.title: 400,000 fewer civil servants, a new pension reform…: Bruno Retailleau's remedy for fixing public finances
en.summary: The Republican party's presidential candidate outlined his five-year financial plan on Monday, proposing 197 billion euros in savings to restore public account balance and move France away from state welfarism, contingent on his election in May.

stories.title: Flying Whales lève enfin 90 millions d’euros pour financer ses dirigeables XXL

en.title: Flying Whales raises 90 million euros to finance its XXL airships
en.summary: Flying Whales completed a funding round of 90 million euros after two years of negotiations, with French strategic investors joining existing shareholders. The funding secures the company until its XXL airship's first flight scheduled for late 2028 in Gironde.

stories.title: Accident d’un avion Elixir : la perte d’un volet gauche à l’origine

en.title: Elixir aircraft accident: loss of left flap at origin
en.summary: Two employees of French company Elixir Aircraft died in an accident involving one of the company's two-seat aircraft on October 1st. French aviation authorities concluded that detachment of the left flap during a turn caused the crash.

stories.title: ▶️Industrie du tourisme : le premium confirmé comme levier d’attractivité

en.title: Tourism industry: premium segment confirmed as attractiveness lever
en.summary: A program discussing tourism industry trends highlights the premium segment as a key factor in attracting visitors and economic growth.
